_comment: Model pin policy read by hooks/lib/model-pin.py (spawn-ledger agent.spawn hook). Category entries are EMPTY on purpose: empty = use "default". A spawner picks a category with a line `MODEL-CATEGORY: <name>` (or `[category:<name>]`) in the prompt/description. Named agents ignore this file: their frontmatter model: wins. exec_cap: max Execs running per ROOT PD across its whole tree (coords, mini-coords, direct Execs; coords never count); chain with no PD ancestor is exempt, unresolvable chain fails open. Kill switches: MODEL_PIN_OFF=1 | state/model-pin.off | .hook-profile=minimal (everything); SPAWN_CAP_OFF=1 | state/spawn-cap.off (cap only). EFFORT POLICY (Owner ruling 2026-10-15): the `effort` section is the SINGLE source of truth for the reasoning effort of every spawn; model-pin.py decide_effort() picks a category per spawn and returns its value as `effort` + `effort_category` (the spawn-ledger turn.step hook applies it; agent.spawn cannot set effort). Order: PD (-pd / pd-coordinator) -> `agents` table (named non-PD agents) -> general-purpose: MODEL-CATEGORY marker in `marker_categories`, else the Jev route cache entry named by the prompt's Jev[r=<id>] line (domain -> family via `domains`; content + lang vi or domain writing-vi -> content_vi; coding -> coding_complex when a `complexity` domain/skill/marker fires else coding_routine), else `fallback_category`. Allowed values: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Every PD agent def carries `effort: medium` (mirror); non-PD defs carry no effort line. Kill switches (effort only): EFFORT_POLICY_OFF=1 | state/effort-policy.off | effort.enabled=false; the model-pin switches above cover everything.
